scientific_integrity: The decomposition theorem of Higashitani, Padrol, and Sanyal is cited as established; new claims are the exact cardinality-refined count and sharp arithmetic asymptotic. All finite computations are reproducibility checks, not exhaustive proofs of infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Fixed vertex count k as ambient dimension d tends to infinity; excludes constant-coordinate sets and does not impose affine full dimension. Exact counts use labeled coordinates. No growing-k uniformity or cube-symmetry orbit count. Historical priority may be affected by equivalent Boolean-relation enumerations.
title: Sharp fixed-vertex-count law for Minkowski decomposition of Boolean polytopes
